exposure: emergency cesarean section (CS) for breech presentation
elective cesarean section (CS) for breech presentation
outcome: decrease in hemoglobin values before and after CS
cohort: The study included all patients who underwent cesarean delivery with the indication of breech presentation between January 2016 and December 2018.
finding: Emergency cesarean section for breech presentation was associated with significantly lower neonatal APGAR scores, worse maternal postoperative hemoglobin values, and longer operation times compared to elective cesarean section, with increased adverse outcomes correlating with preoperative cervical dilation.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections for breech presentation resulted in significantly lower neonatal APGAR scores and postoperative maternal hemoglobin values, and longer operation times compared to elective cesarean sections.
gest_age: 37 gestational weeks (median for emergency CS) and >=38 gestational weeks (for elective CS)
